recognize_zh: 低倍下皮下脂肪小葉間與脂肪細胞之間佈滿淋巴樣細胞，呈小葉性脂膜炎樣（lobular panniculitis-like）浸潤，並包圍小血管與毛囊附屬器；HV-LPD的浸潤常延伸到皮下脂肪，這張圖正顯示這種深層侵犯。
features: Lymphoid infiltrate permeating subcutaneous fat lobules between adipocytes (lobular panniculitis-like pattern)
Perivascular and perineural/periadnexal cuffing around a small vessel or nerve twig at center
Hair follicle epithelium at upper right surrounded by lymphocytes
Cells appear small to medium; rimming of individual adipocytes is not clearly resolved at this magnification
No fat necrosis or granulomas evident in this field
describe_en: Low-power sections of deep dermis and subcutis show a lymphoid infiltrate permeating subcutaneous fat lobules in a lobular panniculitis-like pattern, with cuffing around a small neurovascular bundle and a hair follicle. The infiltrating cells are small to medium-sized at this magnification, and definite adipocyte rimming, fat necrosis or granulomas are not evident. Extension of the infiltrate into the subcutis in a patient with photodistributed vesiculopapular lesions and an EBER-positive cytotoxic infiltrate is consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: SPTCL shows atypical CD8+ alpha-beta T cells rimming adipocytes with karyorrhexis, spares the dermis and epidermis, and is EBER-negative.
Gamma-delta TCL involves epidermis, dermis and fat with necrosis and angioinvasion, expresses TCR-gamma with TCR-beta-F1 negativity, and is EBER-negative.
Lupus panniculitis shows hyaline fat necrosis, lymphoid follicles with plasma cells and mucin, with a polyclonal EBER-negative infiltrate.
